newsitem.title: GERMANY: German govt agency confirms jet, diesel tender.
newsitem.headline: German govt agency confirms jet, diesel tender.

text.p: German agency Erdoelbevorratungsverband (EBV) has tendered to buy 250,000 tonnes of jet fuel A1 and 250,000 tonnes of diesel, an EBV official said on Monday.
He confirmed information obtained from traders last Friday that EBV, which regulates compulsory stocks, was in the process of drawing up details and set to contact potential suppliers.
"We have informed our partners in the market," he said.
The deadline for bids is next Tuesday, May 6, 1200 local time and decisions will be made between 1200 and 1700 local on that day.
EBV does not have to buy the maximum tonnage if it disagrees with the prices offered and it does not publicise the results of the tender, the official added.
